title: Named Non-Owner Policy Conversion to a Cardinal Point Owner Auto Policy
content:
When the named insured buys or leases a vehicle and insures it on a Cardinal Point Owner Auto Policy, the Named Non-Owner Policy term is cancelled as a conversion.

- **Precondition.** A conversion cancellation is processed only after an Owner Auto Policy term of the same named insured has been bound; the owner term recorded as the replacing term must show the status bound or in force.
- **Effective date.** The cancellation takes effect on the effective date of the replacing owner term, even when that date is earlier than the processing date, and the non-owner term records that owner term as the term it was converted to.
- **Return.** The unearned premium is returned pro rata with no short-rate retention.
- **Certificates.** An SR-22 or FR-44 Operator certificate on the non-owner term is not moved: the owner term needs its own Owner-Operator filing, and the operator certificate receives its SR-26 under the filing rules.

| Replacing owner term status | Conversion cancellation |
|---|---|
| bound | may be processed |
| in force | may be processed |
| not yet bound (quoted only) | not processed |

*Hypothetical:* an owner term bound on 12 October with an effective date of 10 October; the non-owner term cancels effective 10 October although the conversion is processed on 12 October.
